entries.en: arithmetic; the art of reckoning

entries.zh: 芒（谷穗上的芒刺）；亦指锋尖
entries.en: awn (beard of grain); also a sharp point or edge
entries.notes: L 栏 dequalguier asa 拼合可疑，M 栏仅存 one ..，故只能依 H 芒 与 R mâng 定其大义。

entries.en: awn of grain; rice awn
entries.notes: L 作 arista de arroot，应是 arista de arroz；H 第二字「賣」与义不合，疑为「芒」之讹，M cheg miē（粟米）旁证为谷芒。

entries.en: to put on (clothing); to dress for arms
entries.notes: M 栏作 choan ı chuy. 末字残缺，R 亦仅 chŭen，依 H 穿 与 L armarse 定作穿衣披挂。

entries.en: to put on armour; to arm oneself
to set a trap; to lay a snare
entries.notes: L 之 brampas 疑为 trampas 之讹；H 栏标 [疑:陷/階]，依 M hăm、R hiān 定作 陷。

entries.zh: 设陷阱使人跌入；使人陷身而倒
entries.en: to lay a trap so that someone falls in; to trip someone into a snare
entries.notes: H 栏标 [疑:陷/階]；「身倒」示跌仆之状，L 明言 para que caiga，末音有缺损。

entries.en: to dig a pitfall; to make a pit trap
entries.notes: H 栏标 [疑:陷/階]，而 L 附拉丁语 facere foveam（掘坑）可确证为 陷阱；R 栏 hî chîn 与 陷阱 对音不整。

entries.en: to span a crossbow; to bend a bow
to span a crossbow; to draw a crossbow
to spread a net; to set a fishing net
entries.notes: L 之 aromar 当为 armar 之讹（本条仍属 armar 系列），H 張網、M tio băng、R chiăng vàng 三者相合。

entries.en: to draw a bow; to bend a bow
to arm the body with armour; to put on a breast-guard
entries.notes: L 末 cubrillos 费解（疑为 cubrir los），H 掩心甲 与 M iăm sīn ca、R xiăm sīm guīa 大致相合。

entries.en: to arm oneself; to put on armour
entries.notes: H 第二字「捕」于此义无着，疑为衍字或属下条；依 H 甲 与 L armarse 定作披甲。

entries.en: arms; weaponry; military equipment
entries.notes: L 仅作 Arm，疑为 armas 之截断；H 戎、M Xiōng、R xiōng 相合。

entries.en: arms; military force; martial affairs
armour; coat of mail
weapons; lethal instruments
military weapons; munitions
offensive weapons; blades and arms of attack

entries.zh: 金拳头（铁制拳套／指虎，中国式近身兵器）
entries.en: golden fist — an iron knuckle-duster (steel fist weapon)
bedstead; bed frame (frame for a canopy or mosquito net)
entries.notes: L 为 armazón de la cama（床架），H 作「蚊帳簟」兼含蚊帐与竹簟，名实不完全对等，M／R 并有 T99 缺损。
